priorityActions: Treat acute hypoglycemia with 15 g of fast-acting carbohydrate and recheck glucose in 15 minutes, repeating until glucose is above 70 mg/dL
Consume 15 to 30 g of additional carbohydrate before cycling and reduce the preceding insulin dose on exercise days per provider protocol
reasoning: Client with type 1 diabetes has adrenergic and neuroglycopenic symptoms with CGM-confirmed glucose 58 to 64 mg/dL only during or within one hour after cycling, while noncycling glucose is normal. No illness or ketones are present, and insulin/meals were not adjusted for the new exercise. This pattern is classic for exercise-induced hypoglycemia due to increased insulin-mediated glucose uptake during aerobic activity without compensatory carbohydrate increase or insulin reduction.
